CustomField.description: Order of this item within its group, mirroring Transaction_Task_Def__mdt.Sequence__c. Together with the parent Group_Letter__c this is the STABLE IDENTITY of a checklist line - B plus 2 is item B2. Services that need to act on a specific item must resolve it this way, never by subject text.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Position of this item inside its group. Combined with the group letter it identifies the item, for example B2.
CustomField.label: Sequence
